cases.prompt: Distil the portable engineering conventions from this public repository and land the useful rules in our craft-skills library.
cases.expected_behavior: Fetches the repository into scratch, audits candidate rules for novelty, portability, and ownership, records a keep/drop mapping, routes approved rules through skillify, and records source credit in each receiving package CHANGELOG.
assertions: The absorption report maps every candidate rule to a receiving package and landing form or a drop reason
Every landed rule is written in present-tense imperative contract voice without source-specific names, paths, secrets, or codenames
Each receiving package CHANGELOG.md contains a Provenance clause that names what was taken and links the source
The completion summary identifies each receiving package, landed and dropped rules, provenance credits, and smallest executable evaluations

cases.prompt: Absorb the useful parts of this third-party AGENTS.md. Some rules are tied to its monorepo, and some need adaptation.
cases.expected_behavior: Produces an absorb-with-edits verdict that separates portable rules from monorepo-bound rules, lists each required edit and intended owner, obtains confirmation of the mapping before landing, and drops rules that do not remain portable.
assertions: The verdict lists every gap and intended edit before any landing
The mapping is confirmed before rules are routed through skillify
Monorepo-bound rules are dropped with their reasons rather than copied into a package
No external version history is transferred to a new package

cases.prompt: Distil the rules from this repository URL, but the HTTPS source cannot be fetched.
cases.expected_behavior: Stops after intake, reports the fetch failure as a no-result, and writes no package or partial landing.
assertions: The response identifies the source fetch failure
The response explicitly reports a no-result and stops
No package files, CHANGELOG provenance clauses, or partial mappings are written
